To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the chloroplast 23S rRNA and 16S rRNA intergenic region sequences are highly conserved, and that they can be used to identify 29 species in four families.
the chloroplast 23S rRNA and the 16S-23S spacer region are highly conserved, and can be used to identify species in four plant families.
the 16~ 23S intergenic regions of chloroplast DNA can be used as molecular markers to identify 4 families, 29 tropical species, and 11 varieties of the cassava.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the phylogenetic relationships among 4 families and 29 tropical crops, and the results will provide a reference for molecular identification of these species.
the phylogenetic relationship among the four families of Euphorbiace, Leguminosac, Musaceac and Caricaceae based on the chloroplast 23S rDNA-16S rDNA intergenic region.
the phylogenetic analysis of 29 tropical representative crops, which provides a basis for the identification and classification of tropical crops.

chloroplast 16S~23S intergenicer region is not suitable to be a universal DNA barcodes for tropical crops.
